description: This PHP source file defines the AjaxDashboardController class, which extends DashboardController and provides various AJAX endpoints for user dashboard functionalities such as project suggestions, user projects, invested projects, project materials, matcher actions, social commitment suggestions, and SDG footprint data.

classes.name: AjaxDashboardController
classes.description: Controller class providing AJAX endpoints for user dashboard interactions such as project suggestions, user projects, investments, project materials, matcher actions, social commitment SDG suggestions, and footprint-based SDG list.

methods.name: projectsInterestsAction
methods.description: Handles project suggestions based on user interests, updates interests, and returns a list of projects.

methods.name: projectsMineAction
methods.description: Retrieves projects created by the current user.

methods.name: projectsInvestedAction
methods.description: Retrieves projects in which the user has invested.

methods.name: projectMaterialsTableAction
methods.description: Returns the materials table for a specific project if the user has view permissions.

methods.name: joinMatcherAction
methods.description: Handles accepting, rejecting, activating, or discarding a matcher for a project.

methods.name: odsSuggestionAction
methods.description: Provides SDG suggestions based on a social commitment.

methods.name: sdgFootprintAction
methods.description: Returns a list of SDGs based on a specified footprint.
